nodes.label: LUCA Health OS
nodes.rationale: Enterprise-grade Health Operating System (B2B2C) connecting Patients, Doctors, Pharmacies, and Clinics. Built on Next.js App Router with TypeScript strict mode.

nodes.label: Feature-Based Architecture
nodes.rationale: Business logic grouped by domain under src/features/ (auth, consultations, marketplace). Each feature has its own components/, hooks/, schemas/, types/ subdirectories. Prevents dumping all components into src/components.

nodes.label: Clean & Elevated Design Language
nodes.rationale: Design language must inspire trust, hygiene, and premium technology. Prohibits neo-brutalism. Primary color is Teal, uses Plus Jakarta Sans typography, bg-slate-50 for app backgrounds.

nodes.label: Notion-Isomatic Design System
nodes.rationale: LUCA design system inspired by Notion's minimal aesthetic. Zero shadows (shadow-none), pharmako-* token namespace for all colors, borders and semantic states. Separates Doctor/Patient (blue primary) and Pharmacy/Medications (teal care) palettes.

nodes.label: Pharmako Design Token System
nodes.rationale: All surfaces, text, borders and semantic states must use pharmako-* prefixed tokens (e.g. bg-pharmako-surface, text-pharmako-text-primary). Raw Tailwind tokens like text-slate-* or bg-teal-* are prohibited in feature code.

nodes.label: LUCA Earth/Green Fluid UI Palette
nodes.rationale: Earth-toned palette with luca-primary (#163422 dark green), luca-accent (#D97B51 terracotta orange), luca-surface (#f5f3ee warm beige). Semantic tokens declared in globals.css @theme inline block for Tailwind v4 auto-generation.

nodes.label: Server Components First Pattern
nodes.rationale: All Next.js pages and layouts must be Server Components. Only add 'use client' at the lowest possible leaf node (interactive buttons, forms). Do NOT use useEffect for data fetching; use TanStack Query hooks instead.

nodes.label: TanStack Query Data Fetching Pattern
nodes.rationale: Data fetching via TanStack Query (React Query) + Axios. Custom hooks must live in the respective feature folder. Prohibits useEffect for data fetching.

nodes.label: Role-Based Dashboard Routing
nodes.rationale: Single /dashboard route routes to PatientDashboard, DoctorDashboard, or PharmacyDashboard based on user role (patient | doctor | pharmacy).

nodes.label: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) Workflow
nodes.rationale: All non-trivial features use SDD with artifact sequence: init.md, explore.md, proposal.md, spec.md, design.md, tasks.md. Stored under openspec/changes/YYYY-MM-DD_name/.

nodes.label: Offline-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: Single POST /api/sync endpoint handles bulk push+pull. Client generates UUIDs offline. Upsert with Last-Write-Wins conflict resolution based on updated_at timestamp. Soft deletes supported. Max 500 records per pull with has_more pagination.

nodes.label: DB Table: PatientAccount
nodes.rationale: Global patient identity across LUCA ecosystem. Phone (WhatsApp) is primary identifier, globally unique. One PatientAccount can link to multiple Patient records (one per doctor).

nodes.label: DB Table: User
nodes.rationale: Professional users (DOCTOR, PROVIDER, ADMIN). Controls authentication, plan tier (FREE/PRO/ENTERPRISE), professional branding (logoUrl, signatureUrl).

nodes.label: DB Table: Patient
nodes.rationale: Doctor's CRM medical record for a patient. Owned by userId (doctor). privateNotes never visible to patient via portal. Links to global PatientAccount optionally.

nodes.label: DB Table: Consultation
nodes.rationale: Core clinical encounter following SOAP note structure (Subjective/Objective/Assessment/Plan). dynamicData JSONB stores form template responses. Status: pending→in-progress→completed→cancelled.

nodes.label: DB Table: Prescription
nodes.rationale: Live prescription with publicToken for pharmacy verification via QR. Status: ACTIVE→CANCELLED|EXPIRED. Links to consultation 1:1 optionally.

nodes.label: DB Table: Medication (Vademécum)
nodes.rationale: Global (userId=NULL) and personal (userId=NOT NULL) medication catalog. Fields: activePrinciple, concentration, presentation, administrationRoute.

nodes.label: DB Table: ProviderProfile
nodes.rationale: 1:1 with User (role=PROVIDER). Represents pharmacy or laboratory in the marketplace. isOpen and isVerified control marketplace participation.

nodes.label: DB Table: ClinicBranch
nodes.rationale: Physical location of a clinic. All clinical acts (consultations, prescriptions, invoices) are bound to ClinicBranch (not Clinic) for precise geolocation. Stores lat/lon with DECIMAL(10,8) for accuracy.

nodes.label: DB Table: ClinicBranchMember
nodes.rationale: Links doctor to specific clinic branch with department and officeNumber. Allows a doctor to rotate between multiple branches.

nodes.label: DB Table: FormTemplate
nodes.rationale: Dynamic form builder. userId=NULL means global LUCA template; userId=NOT NULL is doctor's personal template. schemaJson JSONB stores input definitions array.

nodes.label: DB Table: AuditLog (HIPAA)
nodes.rationale: HIPAA compliance. Immutable log of all accesses/changes. Every GET on clinical records must fire a VIEW AuditLog entry. ON DELETE SET NULL on userId so logs persist even if user deleted.

nodes.label: DB Table: PharmacyInventory
nodes.rationale: Optimistic concurrency via version INT column to prevent race conditions on stock. DECIMAL(10,2) for unitPrice (never FLOAT for money).

nodes.label: DB Table: DoctorSchedule
nodes.rationale: Recurring weekly schedule per doctor. Unique per (userId, weekday). Controls appointmentDuration and maxPerSlot.

nodes.label: DB Table: ScheduleException
nodes.rationale: Overrides for VACATION, DAY_OFF, CUSTOM_HOURS. Exceptions are evaluated first in availability validation before schedule base.

nodes.label: DB Table: ClinicSchedule
nodes.rationale: Clinic branch operating hours. Doctor schedules can be more restrictive but never wider than clinic schedule.

nodes.label: DB Table: FollowUp
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp-based patient follow-up reminder linked to Consultation. Status: PENDING→SENT→RESPONDED.

nodes.label: Marketplace B2B2C
nodes.rationale: Connects patients/doctors with pharmacies and laboratories for prescription quote requests. Flow: Doctor creates Rx with publicToken → Patient requests quotes → Pharmacies respond with QuoteOffers → Patient picks best price.

nodes.label: Hybrid Relational + JSONB Schema Pattern
nodes.rationale: Avoids Sparse Tables and EAV anti-pattern. Fixed relational columns for common fields; JSONB indexed columns (dynamicData in Consultation, schemaJson in FormTemplate) for specialty-specific clinical data.

nodes.label: Organisation-Sede (Clinic/Branch) Model
nodes.rationale: Separates Clinic (legal entity/brand) from ClinicBranch (physical location). All clinical acts bound to clinicBranchId for precise geolocation and doctor rotation across branches.

nodes.label: Geographic Normalization (Country/State/City)
nodes.rationale: Three-level geo hierarchy. Entities only store cityId (not stateId or countryId). City deduces its parent hierarchy. Enables precise marketplace geo-filtering.

nodes.label: UUID Native Type vs VARCHAR Decision
nodes.rationale: database.md uses VARCHAR for UUID PKs (37+ bytes), wastes space and slows JOINs. Plan: migrate to native PostgreSQL UUID type (16 bytes binary). UUIDs generated by client offline for sync, mapped to server's internal sequential IDs via hybrid approach.

nodes.label: Row Level Security (RLS) Multi-tenancy
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL RLS policies enforce clinic/doctor data isolation at DB level. Backend sets app.current_user_id session variable per transaction. Prevents API bugs from exposing cross-tenant patient data.

nodes.label: Public Catalog API (Phase 6)
nodes.rationale: Unauthenticated endpoints: GET /public/doctors, GET /public/pharmacies, GET /public/clinics, GET /public/doctors/{id}/availability. Only verified entities (is_verified=true) appear. Supports geo-filter by city_id and specialty_id.

nodes.label: Doctor Scheduling System (Phase 6)
nodes.rationale: Availability validation order: 1) ScheduleException check, 2) DoctorSchedule weekday check, 3) Time range check, 4) maxPerSlot capacity check. Clinic schedule acts as upper bound for doctor schedule.

nodes.label: Offline Sync Conflict Resolution (LWW)
nodes.rationale: Last-Write-Wins based on updated_at timestamps. For appointments, additionally validates slot availability via AvailabilityService. Selective failure: individual record errors don't abort the whole transaction.

nodes.label: Responsive Design Rules (Mobile-First)
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first with Tailwind breakpoints (sm/md/lg/xl/2xl). Prohibits fixed widths like w-[800px]. Tables must be wrapped in overflow-x-auto. Touch targets must be minimum 44x44px on mobile. No modification of business logic (useState, hooks, API calls).

nodes.label: SOAP Note Clinical Documentation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Standard clinical documentation: Subjective (reason/chief complaint), Objective (physicalExam + vitals), Assessment (diagnosis), Plan (treatmentPlan). dynamicData captures specialty-specific form responses.

nodes.label: Prescription Public Token (QR Verification)
nodes.rationale: Unique shareable token on Prescription and MedicalDocument. Embedded in QR code so pharmacies or employers can verify authenticity without LUCA login. Must use cryptographically secure nano ID (min 10 chars).

nodes.label: HIPAA/GDPR Compliance Strategy
nodes.rationale: AuditLog is immutable (no DELETE endpoint). Every GET on clinical data must fire VIEW log entry. Combined with RLS for defense-in-depth. KYC via VerificationDocument module.

nodes.label: DB Table: ProviderBranch
nodes.rationale: Physical branch of pharmacy/lab. isOpen is per-branch so main branch can be 24h while shopping-mall branch is closed.

nodes.label: Zustand Auth Store (useAuthStore)
nodes.rationale: Manages global client state: role, name, token. Located at src/store/auth.ts.

nodes.label: Framer Motion Animation Pattern
nodes.rationale: Framer Motion used exclusively for layout transitions, smart component mounting, complex dialogs. easeOut physics required, never linear. Tailwind animate-in used for micro-interactions.

hyperedges.label: Core Clinical Encounter: Consultation → VitalSign + LabRequest + FormTemplate
Marketplace Quote Flow: Prescription → QuoteRequest → QuoteOffer (ProviderProfile)
LUCA Design System: Notion-Isomatic + Pharmako Tokens + Feature Architecture
